title: Hatsune Miku — A Guiding Song〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Um, what do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Practicing my singing seems unrelated to finding my friends, but is there some connection?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If I'm right, then the power of your feelings affected the sleep-learning machine and allowed you to come here.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: The power of my feelings...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm pretty sure your feelings towards the recital are at play here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That would explain why you heard me singing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And if your friends had similar feelings in their hearts when they used their sleep-learning machines...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then I don't think they're far. They would've been drawn to someone's singing too.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Actually, there are SEKAI full of feelings around here where you can hear singing and band performances.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The people behind those SEKAI all have such strong feelings...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, it wouldn't be strange at all if their songs reached your friends.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Songs reaching them, and drawing them in...

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Aha! I've got it!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Thanks to the sleep-learning machine and this “power of feelings”, we heard songs from you and the people behind those SEKAI. Those led us here.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: In which case, if I sing with feeling too, that will reach them... And it may just lead them to me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can't say if it'll work until we try...

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: That's no issue! If there's even a small chance, we should test it out!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's start our practice!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Yes! I'm ready to learn!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...? You didn't sound so confident at the end there.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: I just learned this for the recital, so I'm a bit uneasy without my sheet music...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Then, let's focus on the parts you have down!
Could you face me, Mametchi?

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Hm? Like this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. This is such a fun song, so I want us to see each other smiling while we sing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ready? I'll start.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Huh...? I think that was the best I've sung it, even though I don't have my sheet music!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: And even when we came together, we were in perfect sync!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It was a short section, but I think we really managed to unite our feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Unite our feelings...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You were looking right at me while we sang together, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you're singing or putting on any musical performance together, making eye contact goes a long way.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, when we were all practicing at school, my eyes were glued to the sheet music...

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Let's do that again, Miku! I want to commit this sensation to memory!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure! Okay, here I go!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: I did it...!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Miku! I sang it properly the whole way through!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Great job, Mametchi. Now you're singing with confidence and having fun!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: It's all thanks to your advice, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: I got too hung up on the sheet music and the model performance.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: To think I failed to turn an eye to my friends singing by my side... This is supposed to be a choir performance.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: C-Could it be my fault that we were never in sync...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't think so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looking at the sheet music, listening to an example and making an effort to sing correctly is important.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd say that effort is what helped you improve so quickly just now.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's keep this up and sing some more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: With enough feeling to reach your friends, wherever they are.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: (Kuchipatchi, Mimitchi, Memetchi...)

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: (I've practiced with Miku and am singing much better.)

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: (I think I could put on a great performance with you all now.)

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: (I want to sing together again!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The feelings are getting stronger with our song...)

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
This voice...!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Miku, I just heard Kuchipatchi singing!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line:
Memetchi and Mimitchi too!
This means...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your song reached them, Mametchi!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: I'm going to keep singing more, and tell them all I'm right here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right! Let's do it together, Mametchi!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I think I heard some familiar voices in those songs...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Our visitors must have ended up in those SEKAI after all.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Did everyone make great new friendships like Mametchi and me?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hehe. I hope Mametchi's friends will tell me all about it when they get here.)
